heading: 1800s
text: Sasai Arasaka is born in the mid-to-late 1800's.

heading: 1800s
text: Yui is born.

heading: 1800s
text: Akio Nagawa is born.
Sasai Arasaka gets married to Yui.
The Arasaka Corporation is founded by Sasai Arasaka.
Saburo Arasaka is born.

heading: 1920s
text: A large influx of Jews arrive in California from Germany and formed the Beth El Congregation.

heading: 1930s
text: The Beth El Congregation would move to a former Baptist Church in Morro Bay.
Antonio Luccessi is born.
World War 2 begins.
Saburo Arasaka is heavily wounded in combat. He is medically discharged from the Imperial Japanese Navy and returns home to Tokyo.
World War 2 ends.
Saburo Arasaka attempts suicide on the day of the Japanese surrender.
Ellen Trieste is born.
Donald Lundee is born.
Valentin Domanevka is born.

heading: 1950s
text: The building that The Armory would later be based in is built.
Dr. Paul Robichaud is born.
Margaret Ellen Goldstein is born.
Sasai Arasaka dies.
Saburo Arasaka assumes control of the Arasaka Corporation and immediately creates its security division to undertake black operations.
General Lupold Korepino is born.
Roland Yee is born.
Douglas Llewellyn is born.
Shintaro Takayama is born.
Colonel Maxwell Von Bruckner is born.
Colonel Emile Lazarus is born.

heading: 1970s
text: The Biograph Theater is built.
Anderson Bennett is born.
Neonila Novikovo is born.
Trenton Parker is born.
Marshall R. Shepard is born.
Nelson Katzadoulos is born.
Elizabeth Kress is born.
Ranolph Christmas is born.
Angus Youngblood is born.
Bruce Skiv is born.
Kei Arasaka is born.
Peter Van Rijen is born.
Lupold Korpino joins the Soviet Army.
Carson Dominguez is born.
Malcolm Youngblood is born.
Ramon Sagsaysay is born.
The State Law and Order Restoration Council launches a coup in Burma and renames the country Myanmar.
April 7: Kerry Eurodyne is born.
November 16: Johnny Silverhand is born in College Station, Texas.
George H.W. Bush is inaugurated as the 41st president of the United States of America.
The Gang of Four - a group made up of the CIA, NSA, FBI and DEA - forms to secretly run the United States of America behind the president's back.
Bradley David Parker Jr is born.
The Cold War ends.
The Berlin Wall falls.
The First Central American War begins - The USA declares open war against the drug cartels of Central & South America.
The Fall of South Africa occurs. Very little information comes out of the country other than rumors of genocide.
London Riots between labor and racial extremists occur.
West and East Germany are reunified.
Warsaw Pact breaks up.
Soviet Union president Gorbachev appoints successor, Andrei Gorborev. The USSR enters into a period of reform.
Night International is formed.
Colonel Emile Lazarus graduates from West Point.
The Quiet War begins - The Gang of Four begins attempts to covertly sabotage European countries.
Eurospace Agency launches the Hermes Spaceplane.
Biotechnica Develops CHOOH2.
The first arcology is built in New Jersey.
Stanford Research Center develops the first artificial muscle fibres, paving the way for the development of Cyberlimbs.
Plans for Coronado City are drawn up.
Chile and Ecuador collapse due to anti-drug crop bioweapons.
Primitive smartguns and vehicle links are in use during the First Central American War.
Gorborev, Gorbachev’s successor, purges the rest of the old USSR hardliners.
The European Economic Community and Eurodollar are established.
The DEA develops artificial plagues to curb the production of drugs in South America, and as a result, multiple drug wars break out.
First use of high energy laser lift arrays in USSR. The first prototype Mass driver is established in the Canary Islands by eight member Eurospace Agency.
Brooke Bailey Atchison is born.
Hua Yuchi forms the Maoist Loyalist Cabal in the Hunan province of China.
The Aldecaldo Clan forms as a protective society in Los Angeles.
As farmland dies, rural populations migrate into the cities. They are labeled as Jodes by the media and deemed parasites.
The Morro Bay Massacre - Biker gangs loot several towns before being driven out by the military.
Arasaka, EBM and Petrochem fund the creation of Coronado City.
James Richard Allen is inaugurated as the 42nd President of the United States of America.
TRC Biologic Interface chips are developed in Munich, West Germany.
The AV-4 is invented to deal with rioting in dense urban areas.
A small yield nuclear device is detonated in New York City. 15000 are killed. Colombian Drug-lords are to blame.
Construction on Coronado City starts.
The first coherent Nomad families appear on the west coast.
The Jodes leave Oklahoma to escape the dust bowl.
The Aldecaldo Clan is forced out of Los Angeles.
Gang wars occur in Miami.
The Australian Government announces plans to recognize aboriginal land.
The EC Ministry for Economics is formed.
INTERPOL is sanctioned to operate outside of EEC borders and begins recruiting from schools.
World Stock Market Collapse - The EEC discovers that the USA has been defrauding the global stock market. This information causes the global economy to collapse overnight.
The First Central American War ends - US forces are repelled by the Central & South American governments.
Nuclear meltdown occurs in Pittsburgh, PA. 257 are killed and cancer rates skyrocket. The area is known as The Pitt from then on. The Aldecaldo Clan is hired to rebuild The Pitt.
Coronado City is founded.
Edward Llewellyn is born.
The Soviet Union ends and the Union of Sovereign Soviet Republics is formed.
Pressure from the Corporations leads the Australian government to recognize corporations over the aboriginals.
Martial Law is declared in Poland.
Richard Night University is founded.
Construction on the Kilimanjaro Mass driver is started by the European Space Agency and Pan-African Alliance.
Yorinobu Arasaka is born.
Anastasia Luccessi is born.
The Grand unification of Ministries and agencies is carried out in Japan.
A Civil war breaks out in China with the Maoist Loyalist Cabal conquering large swaths of the country.
The Bloods gang control all of Miami.
The Emergency Welfare Relocation Program is implemented.
The EEC implements the "Fortress Europe" system, which involves the totalitarian monitoring of citizens and the required carrying of identity cards.
Evienne De Tours is born.
The Collapse of the United States begins.
links: The Collapse of the United States

text: Martial Law is established in the United States.
August 17: U.S. President James Richard Allen is assassinated.
The Lawyer Purge occurs.
The first Boostergangs appear.
Nomad packs become widespread due to the high rate of homelessness.
The Nomad Riots - By now, 1 in 4 Americans are homeless. Hundreds of thousands riot for living space throughout the U.S. In actuality, very few of the participants were Nomads.
Article 9 of the Japanese Constitution is scrapped by Arasaka-backed politicians.
The United States Military withdraws from Japan and Korea.
Millions of homeless people are killed or imprisoned.
Armatech-Luccessi is founded.
State Oil Industries Subcommittee is created, with Anatoly Novikovo on the head.
Lawrence Hilliard Innovation Ltd. is formed.
The Far Asian Co-Prosperity Sphere Group, FACS, is founded by varvious large and small Japanese corporations to counter Arasaka in Japan.
Portugal and Italy finally join the EEC.
The Beth El Congregation is invited to move by Richard Night himself.
The Mideast Meltdown - A nuclear exchange makes most of the Middle East inhospitable. The global fuel supply is cut.
Conflict in the Japanese government begins between right winged Arasaka and the bureaucratic FACS Group.
August 3: Popular musician "Rockerboy" Manson is killed in the United Kingdom.
California's economy follows suit with the rest of the nation, and collapses.
Anatoly Novikovo lays the groundwork for a private army using the remnants of the OMON Unit.
Tycho, the first Moon colony, is founded.
A toxic spill occurs in the Pacific Northwest, wiping out the fishing industries in the area.
The Gang of Four are formally investigated.
The United States Military reforms into Combined Operations Groups.
The Bald Hill political scandal occurs in Japan, 60% of politicians were arrested for bribery charges.
Hong Kong is returned to China from Britain.
Drug and smuggling laws are repealed in Thailand.
Hurricanes hit the coast of Europe, leaving thousands without shelter. Dams begin construction across the coast to curb rising tides.
An earthquake occurs in the Bay of Biscay, causing tsunamis that hit the coast of Spain.
Incidents occur between the Greek military and Turkish immigrants fleeing the Mideast Meltdown.
The Yasubisu Affair occurs. 24 French Police officers are killed by Arasaka Security when attempting to arrest a high level executive.
Ling Po Imports is founded.
A 10.5 Earthquake decimates Los Angeles. 35% of the city is underwater and upwards of 65000 people are killed.
A drought in the Midwest destroys a large amount of crops. Many farms go out of business.
The Luds, a Neo-Luddite group emerges in Kentucky. They begin a spree of bombings that last nearly ten years.
Rory and Lea Murchison are born.
September 20: Richard Night is assassinated by the Mafia. Coronado City is renamed Night City in his honour.
Tsunami Defense Systems is founded by Toshio Yamabatsu, Timothy Davidson, and Michelle Teguchi Langley in Osaka, Japan.
Howard Murchison is assassinated by Colin Powers.
Gerhard Kessler takes control of the International Electric Corporation.
The United States Military undergoes trials for a new rifle to replace the M16A2.
The formation of the Soviet state oil industries is completed and is known as SovOil.

The Martial Law Authority is formed in the United Kingdom. It declares a state of emergency and removes the monarchy. King Charles III, Prince Andrew, and other members of the royal family are forced into exile or detained.
Indonesian President Suharto dies.
Construction begins on the Intercontinental Maglev. At the last minute, the western terminus is changed from Los Angeles to Night City.
The Emergency Welfare Relocation Program is deemed a failure.
The Night of Fire - The KGB, backed by the Organitskaya, attempt to overthrow the government of the USSR but are defeated.
Directive 1998-EC-A-000534 is launched in the EC.
Martial law in the United States ends.
The United States implements the Federal Weapons Statute.
Millennium cults appear in response to the 'threat' of Y2K.
Tycho colony established. A mass driver is constructed to provide raw materials for orbital platforms.
Hanako Arasaka is born.
Ellen Trieste invests in Parker Petrochemicals.
Parker Petrochemicals is granted a license by Biotechnica to grow T. Megasuavis, a component of CHOOH2.
The Public Information Office is formed in the UK.
The Second Korean War begins - hostilities break out along the border between North and South Korea over alleged violated airspace.
Martial Law is declared in Hong Kong after riots break out.
The Jodes, former farmers from the dust-bowl, begin salvage operations in the decimated Los Angeles.
The Bloods Gang is converted into a Nomad group.
Night Corp is founded by Miriam Night, the wife of Richard Night.
Crystal Palace Space Station begins construction.
The Wasting Plague spreads across the United States and Europe.
Firestorms rage across the Pacific Northwest, decimating farmland and old-grown forests.
The first Posergangs emerge.
Millennium Cult run amok on Jan 1st in an orgy of suicide and violence, most destroy themselves.
Donald Lundee joins Armatech-Luccessi as CEO.
The Olympic Games in Sydney Australia fail due to bankruptcy.
Orbital Air begin construction on a spaceport in Cape York Australia.
The Blood Nation leaves Florida on their first "national tour".
The Aldecaldo Clan begin the reconstruction of Mexico City.
The Civilian Justice code is formed in the United States.
A Millennium Cult kills upwards of 19000 in a chemical attack in Berlin.
EBM Begins to purchase Hamburg, Germany.
Alaska becomes a free state.
The World Sat Network is constructed. The Framework for the Net is set up.
Armatech-Luccessi is renamed Militech Arms International.
The Japan Aerospace Bureau is established.
A Military coup occurs in Britain and the British Monarchy collapses.
Australia reforms as the Federal Republic of Australia. West Australia declares independence after rejecting the new government and are backed by Arasaka.
The Jodes finish the salvage operation in Los Angeles. Most clans do not win any construction contracts and are left out of a job as a result.
As a result of the Wasting Plague decimating the population, Greece loosens its immigration policy.
King Hassan II of Morocco dies of the Wasting Plague. His son Mohammad becomes king and keeps his father's policy of closing ties with Europe.
The Food Crash - crops around the world are hit by a new virus. The United States survives after developing a counter agent.
SovOil declares itself independent of the USSR government. As a result. Gorborev resigns in disgrace.
Igor Starobin is named president of the USSR.
Lupold Korepino is promoted to General of the Soviet Army.
Valentin Domanevka joins SovOil.
Copernicus, the second Moon Colony is founded.
The Santorini Volcano erupts in the Aegean sea, many Greek Islands are hit hard by Tsunamis.
Portugal, in an effort to decrease Spains influence over them, contracts law enforcement to Amazonian Security and Arasaka.
Spain's parliament breaks down due to widespread corruption. Smaller political parties and yearly elections now make long-term decision-making almost impossible.
California declares itself a Free State.
Directive 2002-EC-A-000306 is launched in the EC.
The Second Central American War begins - As a desperate power-move, the USA once again declares war on drug cartels.
The Gang of Four begins to crumble under new reforms.
U.S. President Harold Harrison Hunt is murdered. Secretary of Defense, John Seward takes charge as acting president and a second period of martial law begins.
World News Service star Tesla Johanneson exposes the NSA for orchestrating the First Central American War.
Louis Parker dies, his son Trenton Parker assumes control of Petrochem.
The Khmer Rouge is driven out of Cambodia and deposes the government of Laos.
The Jodes return to agriculture.
Sugo Manufacturing merges with Mitsubishi and is renamed Mitsubishi-Sugo.

The EEC rules that European citizens can hold their tax payments for up to three years if there’s significant evidence of abuse of funds by their government. If ruled against by the international court, offenders are required to pay back tax plus interest.
Following Morocco's example, Tunisia enters the EEC sphere of influence.
Samurai is founded.
Directive 2003-EC-A-001348 is launched in the EC.
Tesla Johanneson is assassinated in Cairo, Egypt by NSA operatives, causing the U.S. to forego a planned return to civilian government and extend martial law for another four years.
The First Corporate War begins - A conflict between Euro Business Machines and Orbital Air over the buyout of Transworld Airlines escalates into open combat.
Cloned tissue is developed.
Peter Kessler is born.
Lupold Korepino joins SovOil.
The CIA and Army unite to finish off the Gang of Four.
General I Ryong Yon launches a coup in South Korea and creates the United Korea junta.
Bureaucratic reformation occurs in the EEC after a major scandal.
Italy legalises the Sicilian Mafia and Neapolitan Camorra as legitimate political parties to curb bribery in the senate. The Nuova Mafia is founded in response.
The Cybermodem is invented, allowing brains to interface with the Net.
EBM Solos attack Tokyo office of Kenjiri Technologies, Killing 18.

The First Corporate War ends - Orbital Air troops breach the compound of Euro Business Machines CEO Ulf Grunwalder and force a surrender. Other corporations realise warfare may be a viable business tactic.
The Mob rule over Night City begins.
Peter Van Rijen joins SovOil.
November 5: Presidential appointee Henry Jacobi is assassinated. Evidence points towards the Montoga Corporation.
November 17: Operation Big Stick - The Mantoga Corporation is asked to leave the country. When they refuse, the US military destroys all Mantoga facilities around the world in just 12 hours.
The Second Korean War ends - China pulls out support, allowing North Korea to be annexed. United Korea is founded, with General I Ryong Yon as its first president.
President I Ryong Yon is killed in a bombing on the presidential palace. General Park is elected President.
The Maoist Loyalist Cabal controls southern China.
The Los Angeles Reconstruction project is finished. Most Nomads leave California.
EBM declares Hamburg an independent nation.
The socialist government of Greece menaces with nationalisations.
The first human clone is grown, leading to the development of artificial organs.
SovOil is granted a licence to produce CHOOH2.
Operation Big Stick officially closes with the last living Mantoga Corporation administrator found and killed in Bonn, Germany.
Cyberlimbs become commonplace among the United States Military.
Vietnam joins the Association of Southeastern Asian Nations.
The Malagay Separatist Movement is launched.
In preparation for the planned Euro/Sov mission to Mars, Operation "Green Man" begins to create humans adapted to the harsher climates through breeding and cloning.
The Greek government is overthrown by the army with corporate backing. Survivors flee to Rhodes and receive help from Turkey.
Lupold Korepino is named commander of the SovOil armed forces.

The Second Corporate War begins - After conflicts over drilling rights in the South China Sea, Petrochem believes SovOil responsible for an accident that destroyed one of their drilling stations and declares war.
Braindances are invented.
Parker Petrochemicals is renamed Petrochemical Associates International.
The Maoist Loyalist Cabal capture Hong Kong and begin a series of pogroms.
New Zealand legalizes Marijuana for the production of Hemp.
Spain redirects funds designated for the rebuilding of towns destroyed by the 1997 earthquake towards hosting the Olympic Games. Civil outrage ensues.
Playland by the Sea is bought out by Tower of Dark and refurbished.

The First Orbital War - United States forces attack a Soviet space installation, the EuroSpace Agency joins the conflict on the side of the soviets. The conflict lasts only a few hours, and ends with Tycho dropping a rock on Colorado Springs.
Alice Springs, in Australia's Northern territory, is also hit by the Tycho Massdriver. 25,000 people are killed.
The band Samurai splits.
November 7: The United States government undergoes a period of reform. Martial law is lifted once again, and free elections occur.
Taiwan declares independence with the assistance of the Arasaka Corporation.
General Jiang Xiax is elected head of the Chinese communist party.
The Intercontinental MagLev project is completed.
The Second Homestead Act is launched to try and repopulate the southwest. Many believe it to be a deliberate attempt to end the Nomad lifestyle.
Greece attempts to annex Cyprus and Macedonia but fails.
Corporations attempt to buy up farmland in the Iberian Peninsula. Portugal sells, but Spain doesn’t.
Joint Euro-Soviet mission to Mars begins.
The Mutual Defense Treaty is signed by the United States and China.
The Mob War begins - Corporations begin operations against the Mafia for control of Night City.
Anatoly Novikovo is assassinated by Petrochem.
Yarno Kurgasyn assumes control of SovOil.
The United States begins operation to take control of the Crystal Palace space station. The Tycho mass driver drops a rock off the coast of Washington, D.C. as a warning.
Indonesia invades Papua New Guinea and renames it East Irian Jaya. The Papua New Guinea government escapes to Wellington, New Zealand.
The Association of Southeastern Asian Nations disbands.
Terrorists bomb the Olympic Games opening ceremony. Among the 12 casualties are King John Charles I and several other members of the royal family. Future king Phillip V survives.
Taking Portugal's lead, Italy begins selling its southern regions to corporations.
Directive 2009-EC-A-000039 is launched in the EC.
The Second Central American War ends - Countless soldiers are left to make the trek home from Panama themselves and are vilified by the media.
Network 54 now controls 62% of all media broadcasting in U.S.
Food Riots occur in Denver, Colorado.
The Lazarus group is formed.
The Second Corporate War ends - SovOil takes de facto control of the South China Sea. It’s discovered the accident that started the war was a genuine accident.
Construction of the O'Neill One space colony begins.
The Corporations and the Triads of Hong Kong ally themselves against the Maoist Loyalist Cabal.
The Night City Psycho Squad is formed by the psychotic Solo Ares.
The Second Homestead Act fails due to inadequate infrastructure support.
The south of Romania is hit by an earthquake. Bucharest is hit hardest as 267 people are killed by its walls collapsing.
Algeria begins hiring corporate paramilitary squads to combat rebels. Media coverage of the skirmishes are extremely popular in Europe.
Corporations "restructure" the Night City Council due to the anarchy of the last decade.
July 13: Bryan LeShawn sets record for deepest independent suit dive, utilizing the Poseidon Fluid Breathing Suit.
The Crystal Palace space station is completed by the EuroSpace Agency.
Joint Euro-Soviet mission to mars is a success.
The Mob War ends - Corporations oust the Mafia as the de facto leaders of Night City.
Marshall R. Shepard joins Petrochem.
Filipino President Ramos is killed and is succeed by President Aguilar.
An experimental Nanotech device is used in Australia, but becomes dangerously out of control. It is abandoned.
An oil rig is hijacked in the Gulf of Mexico and a new Pirate haven is formed, called MetaKey.
Compulsory sale of land below the required level of productivity begin in Portugal.
A majority of Southern Italy is placed under corporate control.
Greece raises taxes to gain funds to fight off partisan movements. Most corporations abandon them.
John Freeman and William Dolarhyde open the Forlorn Hope in Night City.
The Northern Seperation War begins - The northern half of California declares itself independent of the south.
The Wasting Plague is unleashed on Chicago, IL. 1700 are killed.
Gerhard Kessler is assassinated.
Yarno Kurgasyn retires from SovOil.
Arkady Cherminino assumes control of SovOil.
Nanotechnology breakthrough is achieved.
Filipino President Aguilar is killed for cheating in the election. His successor President Lopez is killed on the way to his inauguration.
After the destruction of Chicago, the government orders the construction of Chicago Port. It is the first city built entirely by Nomads.
The Nomad Long Walk ends with only 10% returning home.
Operation "Green Man" is publicly shut down after information leaks to the presses. Both INTERPOL and the European Space Agency continue the project independently.
Drought decimates Spain and a small Corporate war breaks out over water rights. The EC intervenes to stop the conflict.
Italy officially organises itself into four states: north, south, central, and insular.
The Northern Seperation War ends - With the ratification of the Northern Separation Treaty, North California and South California are officially independent states.
Most adventures in the Cyberpunk 2013 series take place.
Netwatch established by joint U.S./ Eurotheatre Treaty.
The first Artificial Intelligence is developed by Microtech.
The Central African conflict begins.
Emperor Showa-Tenno dies and Emperor Shinka-Tenno ascends the throne in Japan.
Maoist Loyalist Cabal leader Hua Yuchi is assassinated.
Filipino President Tiapan is elected.
April 12: Alt Cunningham is kidnapped by Arasaka.
April 13: Johnny Silverhand provokes a riot to invade Arasaka Tower. Alt Cunningham ends up dead, with her digital ghost stuck in the Net.
Johnny Silverhand goes into hiding for a while, with the help of the Aldecaldos.
The reconstruction of Mexico City is completed.
Algeria's anti-terrorism operations extend to Libya, where the rebels train their soldiers.
Eugene Hobson forms StreeTemps.
Turf wars begin in Night City known as The Metal Wars. A section of the city becomes classified as the Combat Zone.
The Ihara-Grubb Transformation Algorithm standardises the Net.
Emperor Shinka-Tenno is removed from power in Japan.
The Peoples Liberation Party regain control of large areas of southern China.
Hong Kong is liberated.
The Association of Southeastern Asian Nations is reformed.
The Amnesty International office in London is bombed. They set up a new HQ in New Zealand.
The Cape York spaceport completes construction.
Kizamasu Inc. own major portion of Houston to build corporate city.
Neo-Catholic Reformation - Celibacy is abolished and women are allowed to become priests. The Church of Poland splits off from the Vatican.
Portuguese farmers immigrate to Spain and France.
Lithuania hires cybernetic Mercenaries to repel an invasion by Latvia. This is one of the first big uses of what would become known as Solos.
Douglas Llewellyn joins the Lazarus Group.
Nanotechnology becomes commercially available.
Japan is removed from the EEC after ten years of conflict.
Japan establishes the New Yen currency.
The Yen War begins in Europe, with Germany aiming to limit international corporations in Europe.
MetaCorp is founded.
The EEC declares that all combat-oriented Cyberware held by civilians must be registered and a psychological evaluation must be passed or the Cyberware will be removed.
Spain ends its suppression of AgriCorps. Highwaymen begin re-appearing as a result.
Europa Sur, an alliance of criminal organisations, is founded.
Eugene Hobson dies.
The Third Corporate War begins - Merrill, Asukaga & Finch discovers a confidence scheme organised by the Rothstein Fund. Hostilities break out entirely over the Net.
Angus Youngblood and Ellen Trieste get married via the Net.
The O'Neill One space colony completes construction.
Bioware becomes commercially available.
The Scottish Uprising begins.
Water riots begin in Australia. Arasaka funds construction of a desalination plant.
The Bermeo Incident - 127 protesters are killed by corporate security teams.
Jihadists begin to preach against a westernising Morocco and Tunisia.
Blair is inaugurated as President of the United States of America. His vice president is Elizabeth Kress.
The first self-aware human clone is created.
The O'Neill Two space colony is completed and named Galileo Cylinder.
NASA launches a mission to Mars.
Imperial Metropolitan Agriculture forces capture Bristol, dealing a blow to the Martial Law Authority and strengthening the Restoration movement.
London is flooded as the Thames flood barriers are bombed.

The Martial Law Authority is disbanded and the monarchy is restored in the United Kingdom. Princess Beatrice is crowned Queen Victoria II in Westminster Abbey a week later. A new period of martial law is declared to maintain order while the UK's districts are reorganized and the Democratic Government Committee debates how to set up the new Parliament. The DGC has yet to issue a final report as of 2020.
Arasaka discovers precious natural deposits under a facility in Africa. Militech supports the native population in removing Arasaka, they fail and Arasaka buy the rights to the land.
The Seven Nomad Nations are officially established.
MetaCorp sells the JackSuit, the first Assisted Combat Personal Armor, to Militech.
A neurotoxin spill occurs in the Latvian town of Jelgava. Lithuania is to blame.
Germany signs a deal allowing their troops to train in Hungary in exchange for supporting them militarily.
Directive 2017-EC-A-001021 is launched in the EC.
EuroSpace Agency launches a mission to Jupiter.
The European Brushfire Wars begin.
The O'Neill Three space colony is completed and named Paradise Station.
The EuroSpace Agency sends another joint mission to Mars with SovOil.
Human cloning laws are passed in Europe.
The Pirate Haven of MetaKey is moved to Tampa, Florida to begin the salvage operation of the city.
Poland is attacked by Czechoslovakia, but the invasion is repelled.
Romania invades Bulgaria.
Rolf Schneider is elected president of the European Council.
Evienne De Tours is elected to join the European Council.
Interpol launches their organized crime division.
Greece annexes Macedonia with the aid of Albania. In retaliation, Serbia invades Albania.
The European Space Agency begins a mission to Jupiter.
The first laws against Cloning of sentient beings are passed in the EEC.
Terrorist attacks are performed across Italy by the Nuova Mafia. Sections of Southern Italy are placed under martial law and remained under it as of 2020.
Pritap Suwarti is assassinated.
Amelia Young dies.
U.S. President Blair falls ill and is incapacitated. His vice president, Elizabeth Kress, becomes acting president.
April 14: President Blair dies. Elizabeth Kress is sworn in as the next President of the United States of America.
L-5 space colonies revolt and declare independence.
L-4 space colonies placed under martial law.
Orbital colony revolt at L-3.
NASA Mars mission is successful.
Emperor Jinkyoku-Tenno ascends the throne in Japan.
Opium production begins anew in the golden triangle of Thailand, Myanmar and Laos.
StormTech begins operations in Chicago, Illinois.
The European Space Agency begins construction of a Mass driver in the Canary Islands.
Albania is annexed by Yugoslavia.
Most adventures in the Cyberpunk 2020 series take place.
The Second Joint SovOil ESA Mars mission is successful.
StormTech contracts the Jodes and the Aldecaldos to begin the Chicago salvage and reconstruction project.
The Snake Nation and Folk Nation are contracted to build an extension of the Intercontinental MagLev to Boston.
The corporate alliance controlling Portugal breaks down. Two rival factions compete for the presidency.
The Carbon Plague ravages Night City for two weeks, then mysteriously stops.
Chicago Rebuilding Project begins.
NASA's crewed Pathfinder mission to Jupiter launches in the summer of 2020. It is expected to reach Jupiter in 2025.
links: Pathfinder: Half a Century of Silence

text: NASA builds a base on Mars, it is called Chryse Base.
StreeTemps open regional offices in San Francisco and Seattle.
Aquacorp IHAG is manipulated towards bankruptcy by EuroBank. Rival Aquacorps OTEC and CINO begin competing to claim their assets, with EuroBank hoping to buy out all three.
The Fourth Corporate War begins - OTEC hires Militech, and conversely CINO hires Arasaka. The long history between the two companies intensifies the conflict beyond EuroBank's expectations.
The events of Cyberpunk: The Arasaka's Plot take place.
Febuary 22nd: EuroBank forces a ceasefire between OTEC and CINO. However, Arasaka and Militech continue covert operations against each other independently.
Rache Bartmoss is killed in a Corporate raid. His dead man switch unleashes the DataKrash virus two weeks later.
The Chicago Rebuilding Project collapses when Arasaka factions detonate a virus bomb to deny the city to Militech.
The DataKrash virus infests 78.2% of the NET.
Industrial factories appear in orbit around Mars.
September 29: The Seven Hour War occurs - O'Neill Two, also known as Galileo Cylinder, secures independence via orbital bombardment.
The ESA and SovOil build a base on Mars, called Isidis Base, and creates a colonial government.
The Civic Order bill is passed in the United Kingdom.
International trade breaks down.
Gargoyles Nomad tribe plans New York City Maglev extension preliminary work to begin.
NASA begins offering commercial flights to Mars.
Contact is lost with the Pathfinder mission to Jupiter after Cape Canaveral and NASA's mission control center are destroyed during the Fourth Corporate War.
May 12: The Forlorn Hope is caught in the conflict and shelled. Several of its regulars die.
August 19: Events of the first half of Cyberpunk 2077YV take place.
August 20:

The Night City Holocaust - A nuclear device is detonated in the Arasaka Towers, destroying much of central Night City. Over a half million people are killed. Another quarter million die in the resulting aftermath.
Events of the second half of Cyberpunk 2077YV take place.
The Time of the Red begins - Atmospheric particles from widespread devastation stains the sky red for two years.
The Forlorn Hope is converted into an emergency shelter.
August 21:
Kei Arasaka is talked into committing seppuku by Spider Murphy.
Events of the epilogue of Cyberpunk 2077YV take place.
Events of Cyberpunk 2077WJ take place.
Militech nationalized by President Elizabeth Kress.
Arasaka forces expelled from continental US.
Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Northern California, and British Colombia unify into the Pacifica Confederation.
The Net is shut down by Rache Bartmoss.

The Japanese government nearly collapses, but saves itself by forcing Arasaka to take the full blame for the destruction of the Fourth Corporate War. Arasaka is forced to confine its operations to Japan for the next several years as it rebuilds its reputation.
The Fourth Corporate War officially ends.
Arasaka is exiled back to Japan.
NASA and the Japanese Aerospace Bureau launch a joint mission to Saturn.
Alt Cunningham establishes Ghost World in the ruins of Hong Kong.
NetWatch officially declares the Net inoperable.
The Diaspora begins - Groups displaced from ruined cities set out to reclaim locations abandoned since the Collapse.
Widespread looting of old tech and abandoned storehouses.
Limited VPNs within corporate parks.
United States is a functional dictatorship under President Elizabeth Kress's State of Emergency.
The opposing sides in the Fourth Corporate War sign a belated formal truce. Militech then tries and fails to reestablish contact with NASA's lost Pathfinder mission.
Staff of the NorCal Military Base swear allegiance to North California, becoming the Estero Bay Military COG.
Kiroshi kidnaps Trace Santiago to use as a bargaining chip with the Aldecaldos. Rogue Amendiares hires the Willows to retrieve him.
Major power players ratify a new charter and officially refound Night City. The surrounding suburbs of North Oak, Westbrook, Heywood, and Pacifica are absorbed into the city.
The Second Comming commits a series of violent terrorist attacks around Night City. Max Hammerman reforms MaxTac as a non-government organization to deal with the situation.
Resettlement of Suburban Night City.
Reestablishing of Nomad High Roads.
Start of CitiNets, local VPNs established in some Reclaimed Cities.
Rumors of Johnny Silverhand's body being found in cold storage in the wreckage of Old Night City arise.
Start of Night City Reconstruction
Ziggurat founded.
Ziggurat develops first CitiNet and Data Pool in Night City.
Rocklin Prosthetics rebrands to Rocklin Augmentics.
July 4: Jefferson Peralez is born.
The Forlorn Hope reopens as a bar after serving as a shelter for 8 years.
Shinobu Nakagawa buys a seat on the Night City Council, officially making Kabuki its own district.
April 10: Elizabeth Peralez is born.
Makigai MaiMai begins production.
A 7.3 magnitude earthquake hits Night City, setting reconstruction back years.
First Wave Cities start Reclamation.
Rebuilding of old factories and old tech begins to be replaced, new corps begin to rise.
Sightings of Morgan Blackhand in various First Wave cities arise.
Netwatch attempts to clear out the R.A.B.I.D.S. but fails, so it shuts down all major nodes into the old NET.
Most cities in the New United States, Pacifica Confed, Free States, and Canada have Citinets and Data Pools courtesy of Ziggurat.
First Megabuildings constructed to handle population growth.
Events of the Black Dog story take place.
Construction begins on the NCX Spaceport.
The Night City Council establishes the Heywood Industrial Zone as its own district.
Night City is ravaged by an epidemic of Varicella-H, a treatment-resistant strain of Varicella.
The Port of Night City separates from South Night City and becomes its own district.
Playland by the Sea reopens.
Shelly Simpson buys a seat on the Night City Council, officially making Rancho Coronado a part of Night City.
Shelly Simpson dies. Her seat on the Night City Council remains vacant as of 2045.
The Night City Council votes to make Charter Hill a district independent of New Westbrook.
Night City Hall and the Hall of Justice are opened.
Heywood is split into Santo Domingo and North Heywood.
The Dorado Family claims the Reclamation Zone and takes over management of NCART.
Night Corp proposes the construction of Megabuildings to handle future population growth.
With funding from the Night City Co-Prosperity Sphere, construction of Megabuilding H10 begins.
SK Security buys a seat on the Night City Council, officially making Heywood Docks its own district.
September 3: John Freeman is diagnosed with ALS.
The Badlands Incident - A confrontation between the Aldecaldos and Jodes almost escalates into a full-on war.
Downtown secedes from Little Europe and becomes its own district.
Brick Coleman buys a seat on the Night City Council, officially making the Old Combat Zone an actual district.
Members of the Forlorn Hope rescue squatters at the Brookhaven Co-op from Maelstrom enslavement.
June 1: Events of the A Tale of Hope story take place.
Most adventures in the Cyberpunk RED series take place.
Hilaria 2045 - The Bozos gang splinters off into multiple factions.
The original Forlorn Hope is bombed and a new location is founded in Woodland Park.
Thorton starts production of the Colby C125.
December 29: Song So Mi is born.
Colonel Shiming Xu is appointed the new head of Kang Tao by the government of China.
May 26: Jackie Welles is born.

Shiming Xu's defense company, now debt-free under his leadership, is rebranded Kang Tao. It makes its official debut on the weapons market with the A-22B Chao smart-pistol, making a bold play for a niche dominated by Arasaka.
A major outbreak of "bird flu" occurs in Night City, killing 7,000 people.
April 30: Misty Olszewski is born.
The Hot Zone is fully cleared and construction of a new Corporate Plaza begins.
October 12: V is born.
The United States of America is officially the New United States with a new constitution ratified. Elizabeth Kress steps down as president after three decades in office.
David Whindam is elected as the first president of the NUSA.
Quadra starts production of the Turbo-R 740.
Quadra starts production of the Turbo-R V-Tech.
David Martinez is born.
A second major bird flu outbreak occurs in Night City, killing 10,000 people.
Lucius Rhyne elected to the Night City Council as a member of the Devolutionist Party.
Thorton Colby C125 ends production.

Lagaretta predicts that the pace of technological development of the time would lead to the confirmation of the existence of white holes and the discovery of a theory for quantum gravity within fifteen years.
links: The Valar Mission, Back to Square One

text: A third major bird flu outbreak called the Great Bird Flu of 2061 occurs in Night City, killing 12,000 people.
links: Night After Night with Ziggy Q

text: Haiti is officially abandoned after a series of vicious storms. A large portion of its population resettles in Night City's Pacifica.
Quadra Turbo-R 740 ends production.
The private security company Secure Services Incorporated (SSI) is founded.

July 17: NC Dam Ltd. begins construction of a dam and reservoir outside Night City. Residents of the town of Laguna Bend, set to be flooded by the reservoir, attempt to disrupt construction, but are forcibly evacuated.
The Caribbean Exodus begins - Residents flee the islands, fearing rising sea levels.
May 4: Night City adopts the Avian Extermination Act to quell outbreaks of avian-borne diseases, which claimed tens of thousands of lives in the city across multiple epidemics over the past decade.
2064 Night City Marathon takes place.
March 2: Premiere of Bushidō X: Fade to Black.
January: Rosalind Myers, previously the CEO of Militech, becomes the third President of the New United States of America.
Marc de Santos wins the 2065 Global F1 Championship.
An Arasaka bodyguard intercepts an assassin's bullet, saving the life of the Emperor of Japan.
The Moxes are formed after the death of Elizabeth Borden.
The first permanent human settlement is constructed in Antarctica.
The last wild shark dies.

A major bushfire in Australia kills the entire wild koala population with the exception of one survivor, named "Omega", who becomes the last of her species. A citizen protest prevents authorities from euthanising Omega.

Hunter Hyland is involved in war crimes committed by Kendachi in South America. Officially called a "humanitarian expedition" to Colombia, Hunter recalled that they "drowned those villages in napalm. And we made sure everyone was home first".
January: The Unification War begins - At the direction of President Myers, the New United States of America instigates a campaign to re-annex the Free States.
Higurashi 20-13 Mantis Blades line is discontinued because of a flaw: they interfaced poorly with neural processors and a certain section of the prefrontal cortex.

June 6: During the Unification War, the NUSA carpet bombs Sacramento. Night City, under siege from NUSA forces, receives "humanitarian aid" from the Soviet Union that independent observers claim consists of truckloads of weapons. The Republic of Texas also officially closes its borders to refugees from Night City.

June: The Unification War ends - Arasaka arrives to break the siege of Night City at the request of Councilman Lucius Rhyne. Unwilling to draw Arasaka into the war, President Rosalind Myers reluctantly signs the Treaty of Unification with the Free States to end hostilities. Night City becomes an independent city-state and Lucius Rhyne is elected mayor. For its help, Rhyne welcomes Arasaka back to the city, giving it a seat on the Night City Council and allowing it to rebuild its American headquarters in the new Corpo Plaza.
Events of Cyberpunk 2077TS take place.
Night City becomes an independent city-state.

Kang Tao rapidly expands the "smart guns" market, leaving behind its past competition Nokota and Tekhtronika. Now Kang Tao is competing with the major players like Arasaka and Tsunami Defense Systems.
Arasaka security forces prevent mass riots in San Francisco.
Night City criminalizes the sale of domesticated fowl such as chickens on the grounds that they have become carriers of a plague.
Events of Cyberpunk 2077SC take place.
An outbreak of zoonotic disease called the Rat Fever of 2072 occurs in Night City.
Declan "Brick" Griffin becomes the leader of the Maelstrom gang.
The Voodoo Boys become the de facto rulers of Pacifica after repelling an NCPD task force.
DT&R triples their airship fuel consumption to satisfy Australia's growing need for plastic.

October 24: In Italy, an earthquake kills an estimated 98 people. In Night City, President Rosalind Myers's offer to provide Militech forces for the city's security is sharply criticized by the NCPD Commissioner.
An Arasaka investigation destroys a terrorist cell in Rio de Janeiro, killing all those responsible for a series of attacks.
Nadia begins working for Trauma Team International as a medtech.
Lucyna Kushinada meets Kiwi for the first time, who brings her into Maine's crew.
The supposed remains of Rache Bartmoss are dumped at the Municipal Landfill on the 10th of April.
Sasquatch becomes the leader of the Animals gang.
The Night City Journal names Somalia the #1 tourism destination of 2075.
Events of the first half of Cyberpunk EDGE take place.
Arasaka's counterintelligence unit successfully maintains the security of a corporate summit in Jakarta by thwarting 45 possible sabotage attempts.
NASA's crewed Pathfinder mission to Jupiter remains missing after fifty years of searching for its signal.
Events of the second half of Cyberpunk EDGE take place, with Episodes 6-7 being separated by some months but less than a year.

David Martinez, an edgerunner who had quickly risen to prominence in the previous year, makes his last stand in the Corporate Center of Night City. Media puts the blame of the damage in the surrounding area on a terrorist attack by an unknown party.
Events of Cyberpunk EDGEKIT take place some time after the end of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, but before the prologue of Cyberpunk 2077.
Events of Cyberpunk 2077TT take place before the beginning of Cyberpunk 2077.
October/November: Cyberpunk 2077 Prologue takes place. V and Jackie Welles team up as mercenaries to become legends of Night City.
Arasaka announces the development of the Relic, a unique biochip which users can imprint their personalities on for their descendants to communicate with after they die.
Switzerland's publishing house since 1488 prints its final book and goes bankrupt.

China and India hold an economic summit and sign a trade agreement. China lifts its ban on the export of certain rare earth metals to India, and both countries agree to open their shared border to allow organic persons and biopodders to cross.
Biotechnica geneticists announce they can now revive three extinct species, the North American beaver, swift fox, and eastern cottontail, on-demand for wealthy clients.
Worsening atmospheric conditions reduce the common gull population to critically endangered levels.
Antonio Luccessi, founder of Militech, dies.
April-Before August: Cyberpunk 2077 Acts 1 to 3 take place half a year after the Prologue.
April: V and Jackie are hired by fixer Dexter DeShawn to carry out a heist to steal a special chip prototype known as the Relic from Yorinobu Arasaka's suite in Konpeki Plaza.
Events of Cyberpunk 2077NC take place shortly before The Pickup.
May 1: The Kujira arrives in Night City, aboard are Saburo Arasaka, Hanako Arasaka and Goro Takemura.

The heist at Konpeki Plaza occurs not long after the Kujira's arrival. During the heist, Saburo Arasaka is murdered by his son, Yorinobu. V and Jackie escape Konpeki Plaza with the Relic, but Jackie dies shortly after. V is killed by Dexter to cover his tracks, but is revived by the Relic and rescued by Goro Takemura.
Events of Cyberpunk 2077BO take place around the time of Saburo Arasaka's murder.
Events of Cyberpunk 2077YHMW take place some time after Cyberpunk 2077: Blackout and somewhere around Act 1.
Events of Cyberpunk 2077BCD take place some time after Cyberpunk 2077: You Have My Word and after Act 1.

Yorinobu becomes Arasaka's next CEO, and blames his father's death on Militech, exacerbating tensions between the two corporations. Yorinobu also begins subtly dismantling Arasaka, framing his changes as necessary reforms and financial streamlining.

Mayor Lucius Rhyne of Night City dies. Deputy Mayor Weldon Holt becomes Acting Mayor until a new election is held. Holt, City Councilman Jefferson Peralez, and a slate of less significant individuals announce their candidacy for the election. Peralez eventually wins the election and becomes Night City's next mayor.
After some weeks of rest, V starts to look for a way to cure themselves.
"Omega", the last living wild koala, dies outside Sydney, Australia.
NUSA President Rosalind Myers announces she will seek another term in office.
Militech announces plans to construct a new colony on Mars, and begins selling residential modules.

V, with the help of Panam Palmer, assault a power plant to create an EMP which takes down a Kang Tao AV carrying the Relic designer Anders Hellman. The incident results in a significant power outage for Night City that causes over €$120 million in damage.
Hanako Arasaka is kidnapped by V and Goro Takemura during the Aratama Matsuri festival in Night City. She is later rescued by a strike force led by Adam Smasher.
V manages to contact with Alt Cunningham to find information about Soulkiller.
Mid-Late June: Events of Cyberpunk 2077PL take place.
V confronts their imminent death due to the Relic and chooses their fate. V's decision has potential ramifications for the future of Arasaka and the world.

Mid-Late Summer: Cyberpunk 2077 epilogue takes place. A few months after the assault on Arasaka Tower, V is either at the Arasaka Orbital Station where their Relic chip has been extracted; if they returned from Mikoshi they are on their way to the Crystal Palace or leaving Night City for good; if Johnny was the one to return he leaves the city as well.
April 20–30: Night Corp expects to finalize the first connections of a maglev network connecting Night City to other NUSA cities.
May 3–5: Lizzy Wizzy is scheduled to play concerts at the Crystal Palace as part of her Cosmic Tour.
Winter: The first connections of Night Corp's intercontinental maglev network are planned to become operational.
Moore Technologies plans to release the Artifex, an advanced 3D printer that scans the user's brain to create objects that the user imagines.
Cyberpunk 2077PL epilogue takes place. If V gets the surgery from the NUSA in 2077 they recover from their surgery and wakes up from a two-year coma, then return to Night City.
August 20: Premiere of Bushidō 13: Solitude.
Night Corp's 3-hour maglev connection to Chicago is expected to become operational.
Leading AI analytics predicts, with 74% confidence, that a second hot war between the New United States and the Free States will occur by this year.
Orbital Air launched a space probe equipped with an AI that is expected to reach the extrasolar planet of Proxima Centauri b in 2095.
East and West Germany reunited. Breakup of the old USSR.
ESA launches Hermes Spaceplane. Gorborev, Gorbachev's successor, purges last of old hardliners.
The US-EEC "Quiet War" runs 1992-96
EEC formed. Eurodollar established. DEA/Euro drug war; this is subsumed by the First Central American War.

EEC votes to uniform the currencies of the still-separate countries into the ecu (European Currency Unit), commonly known as the Eurodollar. During these councils the frame for individual currency's inflation, deflation etc, are set. The consequences is that only four nations are fit to join the ECU-union. They are Denmark, Sweden, Austria and Germany.

The core nations of the ecu decide, against the resistance of the other European nations, to bring the ecu into existence. A period of economic turbulence follows in Europe, especially in France and GB. This results in labor uprisings and general rioting.

The four core countries set up a prototype Fortress Europe in violation of the EEC-treaty. Closing their borders to European laborers looking for work, they initiate a mass of illegal immigration. Most of these workers are quickly found and expelled.
High energy laser-lift array used in the USSR. Prototype Massdriver established on the moon by the ESA.
TRC biologic interface chip developed in Munich. By now, all of the Western European nations except Italy and Portugal are ready for the ECU-Union.
The EC Ministry for Economics is founded, a structure to countries advance scientific progress and to set up the gov't of EEC for the confrontation with the rising megacorporations.
Interpo/Europol receives sanction to work outside EEC borders. They begin to recruit their future members from basic school, sending the candidates to exclusive schools and training camps.

World stock markets crash, followed quickly by the U.S. economy. The EEC is not as hard hit as the rest of the world, due to internal trade. To be exact, many EEC-companies profit from other parts of the world.
A new wave of immigrants hit Europe's shores. EEC uses military to enforce its borders. In consequence, many refugees are killed.
A movement of human rights groups rises as word leaks out of the rigorous use of weapons. Some of these groups form terrorist cells to articulate their opinion.
After suffering from extensive strikes, President Walesa again capable of financing itself. declares martial law in Poland.
Kilimanjaro mass-driver begun by ESA and Pan-African Alliance.

The EEC decides to implement the Fortress Europe system Europe-wide. Therefore, the surveillance satellite program is initiated. One strategy to build up the fortress is a totalitarian id card system. The id cards are programmed with the individuals fingerprints, profession, health status and licenses. Many civil rights groups fear a "1984" scenario and react accordingly.
After years of support, Portugal and Italy finally join the EEC.
Mid-East Meltdown. In Europe, border skirmishes erupt as Greek troops try to stem the flow of Turkish refugees fleeing the spreading fallout of the nuclear exchange.

Hurricanes and spring tides hit Europe with unexpected force, leaving hundreds of thousands of people without shelter. The rising tides force the EEC to construct a system of dams that spans most of the coastal regions. The expected building time is ten years. Germany decides to abandon coastal regions.
A brief moment of fear strikes Europe when Germany is slow to pull its 10,000 man relief force out of flooded Gdansk.

A freak earthquake with its epicenter in the Bay of Biscay devastates part of the Basque Country. The greatest harm came from the giant tsunami waves that swept the coast, specially the city of Bilbao.
Armed incidents between the Greek army and Turkish refugees. The Turks were fleeing the fall-out from the Meltdown. Increasing strain in the Greece-Turkey relations. Turkey vetoed again from EC.
Drought American food exports end. To stabilize the NCE Gov'ts. The EEC ships food into major East European cities.

Nights of Fire (KGB coup) in USSR. The Russian Mafia supported by KGB splinter-groups, increases its efforts to expand into the EEC. This is countered by Europol, which starts a "Shadow War" against organized crime in foreign The EC Ministry for Economics is founded, a structure to countries.
After the flooding of aid from Spain and the EC, the independence movement recedes in Euskadi (Basque name for the region). ETA terrorists begin an indefinite truce.

Tycho colony established. Full-scale mass-driver completed. BASF, a large manufacturer in chemicals, gets broken up by the European Ministry for Economics. BASF tried to dictate prices of contracting firms. Such defiance cannot go unpunished.
On Jan. 1 st the world's biggest rave in Berlin is disrupted when a Millennium Cult floods the area with combat gases. The final body count may be 19,000.
Some followers of millennium cults establish local sects, like the Austrian Werwolf and the French Revived Templars of the Sun.
Wasting Plague hits U.S. and Europe; millions die. Germany is especially hard hit. Cure designed at Bioweapons Lab at Neustrelitz, Brandenburg.

After the first cases of wasting plague are made known, the EEC closes its borders, finalizing the Fortress Europe. Most sociologists evaluate the plague as mainly positive due to the reduction in the elderly and poor population. The social care system is again capable of financing itself.
The ESA starts construction of the Crystal Palace. EBM uses its political and economic power to buy up the drowning Hamburg municipal area over the next five years.
EBM uses its political and economic power to buy up the drowning Hamburg municipal area over the next five years.
Severe immigration control and draconian measures reduce the spread of the Wasting Plague in the Iberian peninsula to a minimum. Widespread racial violence against African illegal immigrants.

The ID-card system comes into operation. Even the strongest opposition is defeated by vote, due to the mass of illegal immigrants in 2000. In addition, the surveillance satellite system is in working order. Still immigrants, are smuggled in through Greece and via submarines. Therefore, the council develops the plan of a killzone at their borders, akin to the former Berlin Wall. Later that year, after the destruction of an intruding nuclear submarine, the EEC Council orders the construction of several submarines capable of boarding incoming vessels.
Severe depopulation in Greece as a consequence of the Plague. After the wasting Plague, there is a loosening of immigration rules. Many Arabs come to Greece.
SovOil declares privatization.

The Portuguese government, to decrease Spanish influence in the country contracts police and defense services to two foreign corporations: Amazonian Security and Arasaka. The "Sell Out" begins with an unconcerned EC.

The Parliamentary system breaks down in Spain when most of the professional politicians are shown to be corrupt. As all the traditional parties fall down there is a movement towards "amateurism" in politics, which combined with yearly elections makes long term decision making impossible.
The volcano Santorin, in the Aegean, erupts. Many islands damaged by the tidal waves. Crete is hardly hit.
EEC weapons manufacturers make giant profits by selling arms to the South American Governments.

The European Court of law decides that individual citizens can hold back their tax payments for up to three years, if there are significant grounds for suspicion of abuse of money by the government. In case the court rules against the prosecutor, the tax payment plus interest must be paid.
First Corporate War: EBM battles Orbital Air (over a dozen Corps involved).
Killzone and Europe's submarine fleet is in working condition.

A major scandal occurs when the media documents the corruption in vast parts of the EEC structure. These reports lead to a general outcry of the populace and the refusal to pay taxes. In consequence, the council reforms the bureaucratic structure of the EEC.

Campaign to legalize the situation of the crime syndicates, like the Sicilian Mafia or the Neapolitan Camorra. Instead of working indirectly in politics through bribery and blackmail, they enter it as political parties. As this criminal organizations try to clean their image, other criminal movements appear, like the Nuova Mafia.

EBM, after buying the final tract of Hamburg, begins to build the Hamburg Wall. Peacefully, they declare Hamburg to be an independent nation in association with the EEC. Closely supervised by Europol, they divide the economic interests of EBM Corporation from the nation, EBM Hamburg.
Strong corporation pressure to acquire land and concessions. The Greek socialist government menaces with nationalizations.

In preparation for the planned Euro/Soviet mission to Mars, scientists begin experimenting with human genes. The goal of Operation "Green Man" is to create a human fit to colonize the red planet. The operation uses breeding and cloning techniques with an eye towards producing hardier and more intelligent humans.

A military coup tumbles the Greek government. The Prime Minister, Ioanis Lacanos, is murdered. The GNRC takes power with corporate backing; It is basically the Joint Staff Chiefs. The surviving government take refuge in Rhodes and get Turkish support.
Second Corporate War: SovOil vs Petrochem. For the first time, national governments openly back the corps. Greece's government is replaced by military coup d'etat. Exile government sets up at Rhodes.
Through 2008, the funds for the reconstruction of Bilbao are rerouted by the government for the 2008 Madrid Summer Olympics. Outrage in the Basque Country.
US attacks Soviet space platform MIR XIII. ESA intervenes. Orbital war breaks out between Euros and Yanks; a rock is dropped on Colorado Springs.
Greece military government tries to annex Cyprus and Macedonia, failing in both.

Through 2010, strong pressure from agricorps to acquire land in Southern Europe. The chaotic Spanish government and the resistance of the small landowners blocks the attempt, but the Portuguese government sells its country.

Euro-Soviet mission to Mars departs. Abortive takeover attempt at Crystal Palace by US intelligence using a terrorist group as a cover. The ESA discovers the plan and drops a twelve-ton rock off DC as a warning.

ETA strikes again, in the opening ceremony of the 2008 Olympics. A terrorist attacks with a grenade launcher and hits the authority's tribune. King John Charles I is among the 12 casualties, that also include other members of the Royal House. The future king, Philip VI, survives unharmed. Renewed support of the monarchy and a strong anti-Basque feeling sweep the country.
Seeing the example of Portugal, the North controlled Italian government begins to cede wide areas to corporate interests in southern Italy.

The expansionist policy of the Greek military government fails. They attempt to annex Cyprus and Macedonia, failing in both. Most governments support the exiled government in Rhodes, impeding military actions against h Rhodes becomes a free port.
Romania's south is hit by an earthquake. Bucharest is hit hard, burying 267 people under its concrete walls.
Crystal Palace is completed, ESA controls High Orbit. ESA-Soviet mission reaches Mars.

Compulsory land sales in Portugal. If the productivity is below the level marked by the Government, you have to sell the land. As the Agricorps increase their productivity, by means fair or foul, small landowners are forced to sell.
Most of the productive land of the south of Italy is transferred to corporate control. The northern regions, richer and more industrialized, are not affected.

The Greek military government, economically crippled, rippled, begins a new taxation policy to get funds to fight against the partisan movements recently formed. The EC doesn't intervene, but many Meqacorps begin to pull out of Greece due to the taxes.
First viable nanotech developed jointly by Euro & Japanese Labs.
Operation "Green Man" rocked when word of a living fetus leaks to the public. Even though the original program is disbanded, Europool and ESA continue to follow the project independently.
The Great Drought. In Spain, Andalusia becomes a desert. Corporate war in Spain incited by conflict over rights to water supplies; conflict stopped by EC-intervention.

As a reaction to the land sale and the public agitation, Italy federalizes in four states: North, Center, South and Insular. Although autonomous, the central government remains strong. The Carabinieri, under government control, become its main enforcement arm.

The Great Drought. Portugal sells itself to avoid bankruptcy. In Spain Andalusia becomes a desert. with thousands of displaced people. Water war between Aragon and Catalonia for the Ebro river. A political problem transforms in a corporate war, and only EC intervention avoids further bloodshed. The population of each region support its claims, and tension runs high.

Vatican III: Neo-Catholic Reformation. Celibacy is abolished and women finally get to be priests. In Poland, the Church of Poland is founded, splitting off from the Vatican. Various splinter-sects formed in response world-wide.
Through 2018, brain drain in Portugal. Many disowned landholders and rebels against the corporations flee the country. Strong Portuguese communities in Spain and France.
Rise of the cyber-mercs as Lithuania hires cyber-soldiers to repel invasions by Latvian nations.

The EEC abolishes all military cyberware for use by private persons. All existing cyberware weaponry must be registered and, if a psychological evaluation is failed, is removed. This does not stop the European Military Forces from creating numerous cybersoldiers.
After ten years of mutual sabotage and deception, Japan is kicked out of EEC.
Suppression of agriculture subsidies in Spain. The money is spent in supporting the cities and the coastal touristic zones. First groups of highwaymen appear as a reaction in Andalusia.
Europa Sur appears, an alliance of illegal groups all throughout the Mediterranean Sea, to defend against the EC and Interpol. Soon they control most smuggling and illegal traffic in Southern Europe.
Third Corporate War is fought entirely in the Net. As a result, Europol 3rd Directorate finally gets the money needed for taking a more aggressive stance towards netcrime.

Bermeo Incident: where 127 eco-protesters were killed by corporate security in the Basque touristic resort of Bermeo. From this point on, eco-activists begin to carry weapons and eco-terrorism is born.

Rhodes, with the support of most foreign countries, declares its independence as the Hellenic Republic of Rhodes. The EC ignores Greek complaints and recognizes the country. The partisans become bolder and now control most of Tessaly.
Germany signs deal with Hungary, allowing the German army to train its troops in Hungary in return for the military assistance.
Brushfire wars erupt in New Central Europe.
ESA mission to Jupiter.
First laws that prohibit human cloning at the sentient level are passed Europe.
As a consequence of the terrorist strikes of the Nuova Mafia, many areas in the South, especially Calabria, are under martial law. They remain so today.

With Albanian support Greece finally annexes Macedonia. The Serbs react occupying half of Albania. The Turks are not sure who they hate more, Serbs or Greeks, and don't intervene. The stalemate still continues today.
Orbital colony revolt at L-3. ESA begins construction of an orbital lift launcher on the Canary Islands.
Spain, a loyal ESA member, is set to receive an enormous influx of money and work opportunities. This may be the last chance to get out of the economic pit.
Two rival candidates compete for the presidency in Portugal. This breakdown of the controlling corporate alliance indicates that some changes are afoot in this country.

heading: 1940s
text: Indonesia – Japanese troops invade French Indochina and occupy Vietnam with little French resistance.

heading: 1940s
text: Vietnam – Ho Chi Minh and communist colleagues establish the League for the Independence of Vietnam. Known as the Viet Minh, the movement aims to resist French and Japanese occupation of Vietnam.

heading: 1940s
text: Thailand – Japanese forces land. After negotiations Thailand allows Japanese to advance towards British-controlled Malay Peninsula, Singapore and Burma.

heading: 1940s
text: Philippines – Japanese invade Philippines, and defeat Gen. Douglas MacArthur at Bataan and Corregidor; Quezon establishes government in exile.

heading: 1940s
text: Laos – As WWII spills over into Asia, the Japanese invade and occupy Laos with the cooperation of pro-Vichy French colonial authorities.

heading: 1940s
text: Thailand – Thailand declares war on Britain and US, but Thai ambassador in Washington refuses to deliver declaration to US government.

heading: 1940s
text: Philippines – Quezon dies; Vice President Sergio Osmeña takes presidency; MacArthur reinvades Philippines.

heading: 1940s
text: SEA – Japanese troops occupying Indochina carry out a coup against French authorities and announce an end to the colonial era, declaring Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia independent.

heading: 1940s
text: SEA – Japan is defeated by the Allies in World War II, leaving a power vacuum in Indochina. France begins to reassert its authority over Vietnam.

heading: 1940s
text: Vietnam – Ho Chi Minh declares an independent North Vietnam and models his declaration on the American Declaration of Independence of 1776 in an (unsuccessful) effort to win the support of the United States.

heading: 1940s
text: Thailand – End of World War II. Thailand compelled to return territory it had seized from Laos, Cambodia and Malaya. Exiled King Ananda returns.

heading: 1940s
text: Philippines – MacArthur liberates Manila; Osmeña establishes government.

heading: 1940s
text: Philippines – Philippines becomes independent nation; Manuel Roxas y Acuña elected first president.

heading: 1950s
text: Vietnam – The Peoples Republic of China and the Soviet Union formally recognize the communist Democratic Republic of Vietnam and both begin to supply economic and military aid to communist resistance fighters within the country.

heading: 1950s
text: Vietnam – The United States, identifying the Viet Minh as a Communist threat, steps up military assistance to France for their operations against the Viet Minh.

heading: 1950s
text: Indonesia – Military articulation of doctrines Dwifungsi and Hankamrata: a military role in sociopolitical development as well as security; a requirement that the resources of the people be at the call of the armed forces.

heading: 1950s
text: Laos – The Franco–Lao Treaty of Amity and Association grants full independence to Laos and a Lao delegation attends a conference in Geneva where a regroupment area is set aside for Pathet Lao Forces.

heading: 1950s
text: Laos – Pathet Lao leaders form the Lao Peoples Party (later the Lao Peoples Revolutionary Party) with a broad political front called the Lao Patriotic Front (LPF).

heading: 1950s
text: Vietnam – North Vietnam forces begin to build a supply route through Laos and Cambodia to South Vietnam in an effort to support guerrilla attacks against Diems government in the south. The route becomes known as the Ho Chi Minh Trail and is greatly expanded and enhanced during the Vietnam War.

heading: 1950s
text: Indonesia – Communist insurgency prompts Sukarno to declare martial law.

heading: 1960s
text: Laos – The Geneva Agreement on Laos establishes the second coalition government that balances Pathet Lao and rightist representation with neutralist voting powers.

heading: 1960s
text: Vietnam – The United States backs a South Vietnam military coup against the unpopular Diem, which ends in the brutal killing of Diem and his brother, Ngo Dinh Nhu. Between 1963 and 1965, 12 different governments take the lead in South Vietnam as military coups replace one government after another.

heading: 1960s
text: SEA – The Second Indochina War spills over into Laos. Both the North Vietnamese and US presence increases dramatically and bombing extends along the length of Laos.

heading: 1960s
text: Philippines – Ferdinand Marcos becomes president of The Philippines.

heading: 1960s
text: Thailand – Thailand permits US to use bases there during the Vietnam War. Thai troops fight in South Vietnam.

heading: 1960s
text: Indonesia – Sukarno persuaded to sign over powers to his protégé, Suharto, who takes over presidency. Until 1998, Suharto is re-elected six times in rigged elections.

heading: 1970s
text: Vietnam – The Peoples Army of Vietnam launches the large-scale, three-pronged Easter Offensive against the Army of the Republic of Vietnam and U.S. forces. While North Vietnam gains control of more territory in South Vietnam, the offensive isnt the decisive blow its military leaders had hoped for.

heading: 1970s
text: Philippines – Marcos declares martial law.

heading: 1970s
text: Thailand – Student riots in Bangkok bring about the fall of the military government. Free elections are held but the resulting governments lack stability.

heading: 1970s
text: Vietnam – In the Fall of Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam is seized by communist forces and the government of South Vietnam surrenders. U.S. Marine and Air Force helicopters transport more than 1,000 American civilians and nearly 7,000 South Vietnamese refugees out of Saigon in an 18-hour mass evacuation effort.

heading: 1970s
text: Vietnam – North and South Vietnam are formally unified as the Socialist Republic of Vietnam under hardline communist rule.

heading: 1970s
text: Laos – Communists seize power and declare the Lao Peoples Democratic Republic (LPDR). This ends 650 years of the Lao monarchy.

heading: 1970s
text: Cambodia – The Khmer Rouge enter the capital Phnom Penh, beginning a reign of terror under leader Pol Pot that leaves up to two million people dead through starvation, execution and overwork.

heading: 1970s
text: Thailand – Military takes over again.

heading: 1970s
text: Vietnam – Vietnam is admitted to the United Nations.

heading: 1970s
text: Cambodia – launches bloody incursions into Vietnam.

heading: 1970s
text: Thailand – New constitution promulgated.

heading: 1970s
text: Laos – Agricultural cooperatives are abandoned and first economic reforms introduced.

heading: 1970s
text: Vietnam – Vietnam invades Cambodia.

heading: 1970s
text: Cambodia – Phnom Penh falls to the Vietnamese, who install a new regime. Civil war begins, pitting the Khmer Rouge, nationalists and royalists against each other.

heading: 1980s
text: Philippines - Benigno Aquino goes into exile.

heading: 1980s
text: Philippines - Aquino returns to the Philippines but he is shot

heading: 1980s
text: Cambodia – Hun Sen, a former Khmer Rouge cadre who defected, is appointed as prime minister of Cambodias Vietnam-installed government.

heading: 1980s
text: Philippines – Marcos is forced to flee and Cory Aquino replaces him.

heading: 1980s
text: Vietnam – More liberal economic policies are put into effect. These policies are called Doi Moi.

heading: 1980s
text: Laos – The New Economic Mechanism opens the way for a market economy and foreign investment.

heading: 1980s
text: Laos – A three-month border war breaks out between Laos and Thailand, ending in a truce in February 1988.

heading: 1980s
text: Burma – SLORC takes power in a coup, and changes the countrys name to Myanmar. Most countries around the world start a crippling boycott.

heading: 1980s
text: Cambodia – Vietnam says it has withdrawn from Cambodia.

heading: 1990s
text: Vietnam – Doi Moi policies and giving up on Socialist Economics opens the door to foreign investment.

heading: 1990s
text: World – Stock crash sends industrialized nations scrambling for bigger markets and cheaper labor. SEA countries start to thrive.

heading: 1990s
text: World – Mideast Meltdown sends millions of Islamic refugees swarming to the Islamic countries of SEA, compounding population problems.

heading: 1990s
text: Thailand – Rama XX repeals the anti-drug and smuggling laws, making it a true open market.

heading: 1990s
text: Indonesia – President Suharto dies. Factions start infighting.

heading: 2000s
text: World – The food crash sends rice prices skyrocketing. SEA countries make a fortune on rice, seafood, and synthetic foods.

heading: 2000s
text: Cambodia – Army drives the Khmer Rouge out of Cambodia, into Laos.

heading: 2000s
text: Laos – Khmer Rouge disposes the government.

heading: 2000s
text: Golden Triangle – DEA tailored virus attack wipes out the poppy farms and the local economies. The warlords decide to switch to synthetic drugs, and smuggling/Merc services.

heading: 2000s
text: Hong Kong – HK falls to the MLC, sending thousands of Chinese refugees overseas.

heading: 2000s
text: Vietnam – joins ASEAN.

heading: 2000s
text: South China Sea – The Second Corporate War takes place in the South China Sea. The fight is between Petrochem and SovOil. Pollution fallout destroys thousands of miles of coastline in Vietnam, Malaysia, and the New Philippines, as well as destroying millions of peoples livelihoods.

heading: 2000s
text: Indonesia – Invades and conquers Papua New Guinea, renaming it "East Irian Jaya".

heading: 2000s
text: SEA – ASEAN disbands.

heading: 2010s
text: New Philippines – President Ramos is killed; Pres. Aguilar is elected, promises new constitution.

heading: 2010s
text: New Philippines - President Aguilar is killed for cheating in election. President Lopez is killed on his way to the inauguration.

heading: 2010s
text: New Philippines – President Tiapan is elected and stays in power.

heading: 2010s
text: SEA – ASEAN reforms at the diplomatic urgings of SovOil.

heading: 2010s
text: Golden Triangle - Limited production opium and heroin begins again from new, virus-resistant poppy plants.
